name: Dune MCP
tagline: An MCP server where agents pay per query with a crypto wallet to fetch blockchain analytics.
problem: Agents have no simple way to pay for data they query.
solution: Matches an agent's question to existing analytics queries and requires a payment header settled through a wallet before returning data.
demo_moment: Team-described: an agent asks for trading volume, pays and gets the answer.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Won “Most Creative Solana MCP” among 122 submissions.
Puts payment directly in the agent's data request.

lessons: Pay-per-call is a natural fit for agent data access.
